prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for the JOBE desktop marketing homepage
Primary request: Design a real desktop website surface for JOBE, a founder-led senior engineering consultancy. This is composition B, “DECISION FIELD,” within the approved SYSTEMS WAYFINDING visual world. Show the navigation, complete first viewport, and enough of the following services section to prove the page system. The evidence field leads: a full-width deep-blue architecture map occupies the center and most of the fold, while the JOBE proposition, concise description, founder verdict, and actions attach to its perimeter like an infrastructure-map legend. A single bright route passes through a diagnosis junction and ends at the primary booking action. The visitor must understand senior founder judgment before decorative mood.
Surface structure in order: slim near-white header with JOBE and compact navigation/locale/theme controls; full-width blue diagnostic field with oversized architecture topology; headline integrated at the upper-left edge of the field; description and actions in a hard-edged white legend plate overlapping the lower-left; founder-verdict plate attached to the chosen route on the right; lower fold begins three service outcomes as named route destinations rather than cards.
Style/medium: high-fidelity flat web UI design, precise contemporary infrastructure wayfinding, matte, editorial, production-believable
Composition/framing: 1536x1024 landscape desktop webpage, browserless, straight-on; evidence field occupies about 65% of image height and 80% width; headline large but subordinate to topology scale; white legend plate creates one decisive overlap; services strip visible below; purposeful asymmetry; high diagram density with strong reading order
Color palette: deep engineering blue #173D8F carries 45–55% of the surface, near-white #F5F7FA, ink #111722, pale route blue #9FB5DF only; no second accent hue; no gradients
Typography: authoritative narrow grotesk inspired by infrastructure signage, not a system font, not monospace, uppercase navigational labels and a large compact headline
Materials/components: enamel-signage field, folded-map seams, hard-edged legend plates, clipped corners, 1–2px topology paths, route nodes, index numbers; almost no rounded rectangles; flat depth
Text (verbatim where legible): “JOBE”, “Engineering that Works”, “A senior engineering practice for AI products that need to work in production—and for the business.”, “Book a Product Readiness Call”, “Explore StockCast”, “AI Productization Sprint”, “Fractional CTO & Architecture”, “AI-Native SDLC & Engineering Enablement”. Do not invent any other claims, metrics, customers, credentials, prices, or logos. Minor explanatory text may be greeked.
Founder evidence: include a short attached plate labeled only “JOÃO BERTACCHI” with greeked annotation lines; do not invent a title, biography, or credential.
Responsive intent implied: the central chosen route clearly converts to a vertical mobile rail while peripheral legend plates stack.
Constraints: preserve current homepage section inventory and diagnostic-first story; architecture diagram is meaningful topology, not decorative circuitry; visible primary action; accessible contrast; no browser chrome
Avoid: generic split hero, wireframe cube, three equal floating cards, dashboard chrome, bento grid, gradients, glow, glassmorphism, neon hacker aesthetic, fake data, fake score values, stock illustration, 3D objects, excessive pills, excessive rounded cards, generic AI landing page, watermark
